name: Mosekonen
body:
MOSEKONEN
CR 6

Peering beyond the trees, you can barely make out a woman tending to a bubbling cauldron. Her deep green hair is long and luxurious, in stark contrast to the rags that she wears.

XP 2,400
CN Medium fey (aquatic)
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, mistsight; Perception +17

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural)
hp 71 (11d6+33)
Fort +6, Ref +9, Will +11
Defensive Abilities mist walker; DR 5/cold iron; Immune charm, fear; Resist cold 10, fire 10

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +6 (1d6+1)
Special Attacks cauldron magic
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 6th; concentration +9)

At will—acid arrow, charm person (DC 14), create water, faerie fire, jester’s jaunt (self only), lesser confusion (DC 14), produce flame
3/day—blindness/deafness (DC 15), hideous laughter (DC 15), mind thrust II, silence (DC 15), spike growth (DC 16), summon nature’s ally III

Spells Known (CL 6th; concentration +10)

2nd (4/day)—barkskin, delay poison (DC 16), lesser restoration (DC 16), owl’s wisdom (DC 16)
1st (5/day)—cure light wounds (DC 15), detect animals or plants, magic stone, pass without trace
0 (at will)—detect magic, detect poison, know direction, light, mending (DC 14), purify food and drink (DC 14)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 14, Wis 19, Cha 16
Base Atk +5; CMB +6; CMD 18
Feats Alertness, Dodge, Improved Natural Armor (x2), Improved Natural Attack (claw), Intrinsic Crafter (see page 54)
Skills Bluff +14, Craft (alchemy) +13, Diplomacy +14, Heal +12, Knowledge (geography) +13, Knowledge (nature) +13, Perception +17, Sense Motive +17, Spellcraft +10, Stealth +13 (+17 in swamps), Survival +11, Swim +13; Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth in swamps
Languages Common, Elven, Sylvan
SQ amphibious, change shape (alter self, Small or Medium humanoid), druidic herbalism, swamp stride

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Cauldron Magic (Su)

So long as her cauldron is filled, a mosekonen can bring it to a boil in 10 minutes. As a standard action, a mosekonen can cause a boiling cauldron to overflow with mist, generating a fog cloud in a 20-foot radius, and which expands by 20 feet each round until reaching a maximum radius of 120 feet.

This fog cloud lasts for 1 hour, at which point the mosekonen’s cauldron is empty and must be refilled (using create water, a mosekonen can refill an empty cauldron in 1 minute).

A boiling cauldron can be overturned as a full-round action with a DC 25 Strength check, causing the mist to dissipate in 1 round. This provokes an attack of opportunity and deals 1d6 points of fire damage on anyone making the attempt. A cauldron has hardness 10, 30 hit points, and a break DC of 30.

A mosekonen whose cauldron has been destroyed can create another one by performing a week-long ritual.

If any creature drinks from a mosekonen’s cauldron without her permission, the mosekonen is instantly made aware of it, and can use any of her spell-like abilities on that creature as an immediate action.

Druidic Herbalism (Ex)

While her cauldron is boiling, a mosekonen can create potions as per the Brew Potion feat. She can craft these potions in half the normal time and can create a number of free potions per day equal to her Wisdom modifier. Potions beyond this number require only half the normal cost.

When a creature attempts a Perception or Spellcraft check to identify one of the mosekonen’s potions, the potion appears to have an effect of the mosekonen’s choice unless the creature exceeds the identification DC by 5 or more. The mosekonen must designate this false result when creating the potion. If a creature exceeds the identification DC by 5 or more, it correctly identifies the potion, though not that the mosekonen tried to fool it.

Mist Walker (Su)

Whenever a mosekonen has concealment due to fog or mist, she adds +15% to the miss chance of attacks made against her. Further, against targets in the same bank of fog or mist as herself, she treats all spells with a range of “touch” as ranged touch attacks with a range of 25 + 5 feet per two caster levels (40 feet for most mosekonens).

Spells A mosekonen casts spells as a 6th-level bard but draws her spells exclusively from the druid spell list. She uses Wisdom for her spellcasting ability modifier. A mosekonen recovers her spell slots each day by spending 1 hour at her cauldron while it boils.

Swamp Stride (Ex)

A mosekonen can move through difficult terrain at her normal speed while within a swamp. Magically altered terrain affects a mosekonen normally.

ECOLOGY

Environment any bog, marsh, or swamp
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

Sometimes theorized to be hybrids of trolls and elves, mosekonens are found in swamps and bogs, where they brew various potions and magic-imbued liquids, earning them the nick name “bog wife.” Sometimes hag-like and sometimes beautiful, their hair is always long and green, and their clothes always are bedraggled. They are incredibly good at remaining camouflaged, leading many to doubt their existence.

Mosekonesn see themselves as the protectors of the bogs they choose to inhabit. As such, they tend to take great care of their homes and all the flora and fauna within, taking umbrage to any who would pass through carelessly and injure the residents of her home.

No mortal has ever been privy to what ingredients constitute the mosekonen’s potent magical brew, but many legends exist about the possibilities. What is real, however, is that mosekonen control what effects come out of their brews, offering aid and harm alike with each sip from her cauldron.

While she initially may seem amenable, all tales still advise caution before accepting the bog wife’s ministrations.
